question: Can an instrument of sound-formed speech possess the nature of Śiva as instrument?
premises: Speech can function as an instrument producing sound-forms.
An instrument is limited by its function.
The question concerns whether Śiva-nature belongs to it qua instrument.
inference: The instrument of sound-formed speech does not have Śiva-nature as an instrument.
uncertainties: The syntax is compressed; the verse contrasts instrumentality with Śiva-nature.
plain_english: As an instrument of sound-formed speech, it does not have the nature of Śiva.
